caller_call_target.clause: $subroutine is the function that the caller called (rather than the function containing the caller).

caller_require_use.qualification: dated public-interface contract only; original native/historical interpretation remains separate

caller_visible_frames.clause: the only types of call frames that are visible are subroutine calls and "eval".

eval_failure.clause: "eval" returns "undef" in scalar context, or an empty list in list context, and $@ is set to the error message.

eval_success.clause: If there was no error, $@ is set to the empty string.
